chunks: From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from 'Ubaydullah al-Halabi, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him: Does a man wipe his forehead in prayer if dust sticks to it? He said: 'Yes, Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) used to wipe his forehead in prayer if dust stuck to it.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wipe dust from the forehead during prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* confirms the permissibility of wiping dust from the forehead during prayer, citing the practice of Imam al-Baqir as a normative precedent. It highlights the practical accommodation within Shia jurisprudence for maintaining ritual focus (khushu') when physical distractions like dust arise, reinforcing the balance between external purity and internal devotion.
